He was entrusted to keep and disburse 1,000,160 yuan (100.016? maybe 100.016 thousand? Actually 100.016万元 = 1,000,160 yuan). He misappropriated 300,000 yuan (30万元) and lent to Jiang (江某甲). Later Jiang2 returned 30万元 to the group, repaying the amount taken from Xing.

Thus Xing misappropriated funds he was entrusted with due to his position. This is "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust). The correction lessons: "职务侵占" vs theft. Since he used his position as accountant to misappropriate funds, it's职务侵占.
